notes.title: German translation added
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

Just to let you know, I recently uploaded a new build of BH to Steam which fixes a few misc typos in the English script - and, more importantly, includes a full German translation, courtesy of Saryana.

The all ages version of Blackberry Honey is freely available in German on Steam. If you want to download the adult patch (which is available on Steam, but I believe it is inaccessible in Germany), you can grab it off-site [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OuAsRsPm6aoUVgB9vcf06kQgCT1ibJ18?usp=sharing]here[/url]. To apply it, drop it into Blackberry Honey's game folder and overwrite the existing adult.rpa.

As I said in the Japanese language update, the Japanese language is not supported with the uncensored adult patch. If you want to play the VN in Japanese with the adult content, you'll still need to download a censored version of the patch off-site, which pixellates certain elements of the art, [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1U3pRw1-oGZyNEInUQWv6n0-6BSm3_KHT?usp=sharing]here[/url]. This patch will censor all the adult scenes in every supported language.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/716340/discussions/0/1745647052317313076/]You can find the same info here, translated into Japanese.[/url]

As always, please let me know if this update has introduced any bugs into the game, if you see any spelling/grammar errors, or if you're having issues with the achievements. I'll try to fix everything (in a reasonable time frame).

Thank you everybody for supporting Blackberry Honey, and thank you to the translators who've worked so hard to make this VN available in so many languages! I appreciate it a lot!

- ebi x

notes.title: Japanese translation added
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

Just to let you know, I recently uploaded a new build of BH to Steam which includes a full Japanese translation, courtesy of [url=https://twitter.com/SvntnFls]SvntnFls[/url]!

The all ages base game is available in Japanese via Steam. However, owing to Japanese censorship laws, the fully uncensored adult patch available on Steam is [b]not[/b] in Japanese: downloading the Steam adult patch will remove the Japanese language option from the game altogether.

If you want to read the VN in Japanese and read the adult content, you need to download a censored patch off-site [url=https://drive.google.com/open?id=1OuAsRsPm6aoUVgB9vcf06kQgCT1ibJ18]here[/url]. This patch is functionally the same as the existing Steam adult patch, it just pixellates certain elements in the H scenes so as to comply with Japanese laws. The off-site patch will censor [b]all[/b] the adult scenes in every supported language.

If you're not interested in reading the game in Japanese, you don't need to worry about the off-site patch, and you can continue using the fully uncensored adult patch available on Steam.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/716340/discussions/0/1745647052317313076/]You can find the same info here, translated into Japanese.[/url]

I'm sorry if this causes any complications!

As always, please let me know if this update has introduced any bugs into the game, if you see any spelling/grammatical errors, or if the achievements are failing to trigger. I'll do my best to fix everything (within a reasonable time frame).

Thank you to everybody who has supported Blackberry Honey until now, and thank you to all the translators who have dedicated so much time and energy to this story. It's very much appreciated!

- ebi x

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Just letting you know, I uploaded a new build of BH. It doesn't change anything, apart from (hopefully) fixing a couple of errors with the text display in the Russian translation.

If this update has done anything strange to the game (such as breaking achievements or interfering with save files), please let me know. It would be appreciated. I had to rebuild the whole VN on a newer version of Ren'py, and I'm unsure if that will have any negative consequences.


And in other (unrelated) news, I recently published a new yuri VN on Steam. It's called Rituals in the Dark, and it's a romance story with some spooky elements.
If you're interested, check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1118880/Rituals_in_the_Dark

Thank you!

- ebi x

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

Just letting you know, the story has now been fully translated into Simplified Chinese!
Extra details about the game can be found on BH's itch.io page here:
https://ebihime.itch.io/blackberry-honey

If this patch happens to break anything in the game (particularly the achievements), please let me know!

I'm also aware that there are a few lingering typos in the current build. I have a list of things I'd like to fix in the English script, but a Russian translation is currently in progress. Editing the English script now will make integrating the TL harder, so I'll hold off on changing the English script until the Russian TL is done.

Nevertheless, if you find any typos in the story, please let me know, and I'll make a note to fix them when I can!

- ebi

notes.title: Blackberry Honey update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

As the title says, I've updated the game. This update fixes a few spelling error fixes here and there (thank you to everybody for pointing them out for me!), and edits to a few of the CGs so the character designs remain consistent throughout the story.

This update should also fix the achievement problem some people might have been having, where the game wouldn't trigger certain achievements. However, it will only fix the achievement problem for people who haven't read through the VN yet. If you have read through the VN already and the achievements did not all work, please check the pinned typos/bugs post which gives you advice on how to solve this problem!

Also, every time I update the game via Steam, it will reset all your rpa files to the 'Steam' version. This might annoy people who don't want their rpa files 'reset', so I'll try not to update the Steam build very often so it doesn't inconvenience anybody.

For  more information about this, please look at Blackberry Honey's page on my itch.io account, ebi-hime. Thank you! ❤︎
